title: Shinonome Ena — Frustration, Regret and Gratitude〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <See you, K, Amia...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to lie down for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why'd I go after Mafuyu like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're really just gonna let her have her way...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She threw away something that meant a lot to you, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's like her saying your real thoughts and feelings belong in the trash! Am I wrong...?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Mom...
She cares about...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, fine... Let's say you're right...
Even so, now's not the time for any of that...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You need to show her that you're mad...
Because if you don't, she's gonna smash you to pieces!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm so scared...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm really the worst...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm sorry, Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Ena? Are you awake?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Huh...? Did I fall asleep...?)

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, I just woke up. Gimme a second...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Good morning, Ena.
Actually, it's long since past noon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...? Geez, you're right.
I definitely overslept...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: You say that, but you don't look all that well. Did you catch a cold again after sleeping at your desk...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I slept in my bed.
It's just... I had a lot on my mind about a friend...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, did you two get into an argument?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, it's not like that...
It's about her private life, so I shouldn't say much...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: But you're trying to help her?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well... Yeah, sorta...
But I'm not doing a very good job...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, why do you look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, did I look that way?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm sorry.
I felt proud because you're worrying so much about someone else.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course I'm worried. She's my friend...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I guess it's natural for her to feel that way. I mean, I was so caught up in my own problems during my last year of junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I caused Mom... And even Akito so much trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Seriously, what would've happened to me if they weren't around?)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Ena? Is something wrong? Are you hungry?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I'll be awake for a little while longer, so come down to eat whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, back then, Mom stayed up late every day just for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She always made sure that a hot meal would be waiting for me, which led to her sometimes sleeping in the living room...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's even letting me go back to art class after quitting once...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess your family... Your mother plays a huge role in your life...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Ena? Are you sure you're okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm fine!
I'm still just a bit sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Actually, can I eat now?
I'm kinda hungry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, that didn't sound natural at all...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
I came up here to discuss food with you...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I heard about this wonderful place with delicious pasta and custard pudding from my friends!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: How about we go have lunch there together?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... S-Sure, sounds good...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is she trying to cheer me up...?)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Great! Then it's settled.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
But don't tell Akito or your father.
I can already see the look on their faces after discovering that we secretly went out for pudding.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Just gimme a second to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thanks, Mom...)
